findings.observation: RealtimeCoordinator::next_event polls owner.recv_event before the realtime JoinHandle, so a completed OwnerBackpressure task can coexist with queued lifecycle events that are forwarded first.
findings.impact: A peer-controlled lifecycle flood can continue driving ROM lifecycle state after the realtime core has already classified the attempt as terminal.
findings.recommendation: Give task completion priority over owner events, discard queued owner events once terminal, and add a saturated-owner-queue regression proving no lifecycle forwarding after OwnerBackpressure.
evidence: coop/crates/coop-launcher/src/realtime.rs:161-173 polls owner.recv_event first under biased select.
coop/crates/coop-sidecar/src/realtime.rs:534-543 and 585-595 terminate with OwnerBackpressure when the bounded owner queue fills.
Focused realtime tests contain no saturated owner-event queue race.

findings.observation: The public realtime lifecycle wrapper stops children only when realtime_attempted is true, leaving pre-mint reset, heartbeat, checkpoint, pump, control, and validation failures without fail-closed cleanup.
findings.impact: A terminal authenticated-control failure can return while sidecar, emulator, sockets, pump tasks, and owned artifacts remain live.
findings.recommendation: Stop and reap supervised children on every terminal error independent of mint status, preserve cleanup failure evidence, and assert cleanup for pre-mint reset and control failures.
evidence: coop/crates/coop-launcher/src/session.rs:1939-1981 contains pre-mint error returns before realtime_attempted is set.
coop/crates/coop-launcher/src/session.rs:4314-4335 does not assert child, pump, socket, or artifact teardown.
